obs = observe()

# Vector pointing from red_bin to paper to shift grasp point slightly away from the bin rim
dx = paper_center[0] - bin_center[0]

dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
shift = 0.012  # shift 1.2 cm away from bin to avoid hand collision with rim

        obs["zones"]["red_bin"], clear_offset=0.14, retreat_height=0.15
